decisions.statement: Nothing runs here unless this file is the file bun was given.
The seams are answered afresh on every call rather than held as one record.
The root answered is the root of the repository this file is in.
The process id answered is this process's own.
The environment answered is this process's own.
The console is sent to `oauth-proxy.log` under the log directory named.
An agent id naming a seat sends the console to that seat's log page as well.
An agent id naming no seat yet sends the console to the file until that id names a seat.
The gateway is started with the serving seams the serving module declares.
The subagents held as stopped are followed under the root and the agent the boot settings name.
Going down waits on the rows the transport log has.
A signal is listened for on the process itself.
Nothing here reads an environment variable.
No transport log path reaches the gateway this entry starts.
No transport row is written by the gateway this entry starts.
The port is printed by a call that need not have drained before the exit.

definition: the answers to every seam a gateway process asks for
